Effect

During meetings, a living Necroview can identify dead players' team categories by name color: red for the Impostor team, including Madmates; cyan for Crewmates; and gray for Neutrals and converted identities.

Settings

  • Max: Maximum number that can appear in one match.
  • Spawn Chance: Chance for a player to receive this add-on.
  • Eligibility: Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.
